Synthetic fixture for the InfoGenius casting resolver, shaped like the `visual.character.resolve` result from frankxai/visual-intelligence draft PR 92 (contract taken from PR 92 as relayed; re-check when it merges). Every reference is a short ASCII string (not an image) whose real SHA-256 is declared; the fixture transport writes it to a temp cache laid out `<aa>/<sha256>`. No private bytes, no real character art, no real names or Library IDs. `synthetic.tampered-c` declares a hash its bytes do not match. `synthetic.alpha` carries `confusable_alias_not_merged`; `synthetic.lineage-f` carries `status_conflicts_with_rejected_lineage`; `synthetic.missing-d` has a `not_accessible` missing reference; `synthetic.ambiguous-e` is `ambiguous`; `synthetic.vendor-guest` is class `vendor-guest`, unofficial, rights pending.
